items.title: An evolutionary search discovered better memory designs for AI agents
items.why: MAPE evolved whole memory programs and beat hand-built agent memory by 12% accuracy at a third of the serving cost.

items.title: A Rust rewrite of Postgres now passes all 46,000 of its regression tests
items.why: PGRust used AI plus formal proofs on ~1,000 functions, catching 12 real behavior gaps versus Postgres' own C code.

items.title: Telling yourself 'I'm excited,' not 'I'm calm,' lifts performance under pressure
items.why: A Harvard study: reframing pre-performance nerves as excitement raised scores on speeches, math tests and even karaoke.
items.source: Journal of Experimental Psychology: General (Brooks, Harvard Business School)

items.title: Segment Tree Beats: the trick for range min/max updates lazy tags can't do
items.why: A potential-function proof gives it near-log-n amortized time - the answer when plain lazy propagation breaks down.

items.title: An open-source pool controller runs its whole brain on one small ESP32 board
items.why: Swimming Pool System Open logs pH, chlorine, flow and pressure to Home Assistant - a template for any DIY sensor rig.

items.title: One LED strip plus magnets lights up whichever drawer you open
items.why: An ESP32-C6 reads reed switches over Zigbee to light only the open drawer - one wiring run, not one per LED.

items.title: A single dose of creatine blunted the cognitive hit from an all-nighter
items.why: In a 29-person crossover trial, creatine before 21 hours awake cut the drop in logic and reaction-time scores by up to 12%.

items.title: Stress stops your brain from linking separate memories into a new insight
items.why: fMRI showed stress blocks the memory replay behind inference; a follow-up found active recall practice protects it.

items.title: Zellij 0.46 adds an inbox that flags which terminal session needs your input
items.why: A built-in terminal plus a session-wide attention inbox means no more tab-hopping to find which AI agent is stuck.

items.title: Pressure metrics let systemd kill the right process before an OOM death spiral
items.why: Wire /proc/pressure/memory into systemd-oomd with a few drop-ins to stop swap storms before they freeze your box.
